name: answers
description: Every answer as a JSON object keyed by question id: a choice carries choice, probabilities and confidence; a noul carries noul (the probability that it holds); a score carries score, legend, probabilities and confidence

name: answer
description: The first question's headline answer: the chosen option, the score, or yes/no for a noul

name: confidence
description: The first question's confidence between 0 and 1 (for a noul: the probability of the side given in answer)

name: run_time
description: Inference time of the decision model

name: prompt_length
description: Token amount of the state and questions

name: output_length
description: Always 0: a decision model generates no text
